Manifest has stable root identity/scope and /play standalone launch. Worker caches only five explicit public static resources; API/auth top-level navigation, non-GET, cross-origin and non-navigation/RSC requests bypass interception. Actual HTTP errors are retained, offline navigation uses a static reconnect document, and no private response or mutation is stored/replayed. No skipWaiting, forced reload or new dependency. Versioned cleanup is scoped to owned caches; failed precache rejects installation.

Secure-context registration uses root scope and updateViaCache none. Prompt is consumed once following a click; dismiss/reject and registration failure retain manual guidance. Standalone/appinstalled hides installation UI and listeners clean up. Installed Next metadata code confirms mobile-web-app-capable output; checking that actual metadata plus Apple title/touch icon and standalone manifest is justified.

Inspected actual brand icons including maskable artwork and phone guidance captures. Brand mark is centered, opaque and legible; phone instructions are readable without horizontal overflow. Reinspected the refreshed iPhone guidance capture after the repair. PNG dimension/opacity/maskable safe-zone assertions passed in independent focused tests.
